purpose.zh: 坐姿直腿抬腿（压缩），练 L 撑所需的屈髋力量
purpose.en: Train active hip-flexion compression for L-sit preparation with both legs straight.

text.zh: 躯干前倾，双腿伸直抬离地面，再慢慢放下
text.en: Lean forwards, lift both straight legs off the mat, then lower them slowly

text.zh: 长坐，双手在膝盖两侧撑垫，双腿并拢
text.en: Sit with the legs long and together, with the hands on the mat beside the knees.

text.zh: 从髋部向前折，保持手掌稳定，不向后倒躲开压缩
text.en: Lean forwards at the hips and keep the palms stable rather than leaning back to avoid compression.

text.zh: 脚跟小幅离地，停留后缓慢放下，继续呼吸
text.en: Lift the heels a small distance, pause, and lower slowly while continuing to breathe.

commonErrors.zh: 身体后仰、屈膝或甩腿，代替主动直腿抬起
commonErrors.en: Leaning backwards, bending the knees or swinging the legs instead of actively lifting straight legs.

commonErrors.zh: 手掌滑动、肩部塌下，脚跟突然落地
commonErrors.en: Letting the palms slide or shoulders collapse, or dropping the heels abruptly.

items.zh: 手腕与肩：双手稳定撑垫，支撑压力和前倾程度以舒适为限。
items.en: Wrists and shoulders: keep the hands stable and use a comfortable support pressure and forward lean.

items.zh: 髋前侧与大腿后侧：只在能维持直腿和可控下降的范围内抬起，不强求高度。
items.en: Front of the hips and hamstrings: lift only as far as you can keep the legs straight and lower under control, without forcing height.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制手掌负重、坐姿前倾或主动屈髋时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if weight bearing through the palms, forward sitting or active hip flexion has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One simultaneous lift and lowering of both straight legs counts as one rep; the 8-second source contains two bilateral reps. Preserve default 8 reps per set, not eight per leg. The source holds 1.4 seconds at each peak, not a prescribed extra hold outside the demonstrated rhythm.
definition.movementSides: Both sides move together; no working-side change.
editorialNotes: 源明确躯干前倾且双腿同时抬起；旧HipLab主点坐直/单腿泛称不足以说明压缩，新主点按真实源写，不为复用音频保留歧义。名称使用已有语音读法，稳定ID不变。
双腿合计一次同步抬放算1次，默认8总双腿动作。n-seated-knee-lift为原目录替代，屈膝缩短杠杆的屈髋目标降阶候选，坐姿/支撑不同；没有已核定L撑进阶稳定ID。
源highlight还指定quadRect面片，package保留原spec依赖，须在新版高亮层检查该额外面片是否实际支持并有遮挡；不能仅凭groups认定完整。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。
